name: Fukushima (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Fukushima town emblem in navy: a ring open at the sides enclosing a stylised spire with wings.
history: Municipal flag of Fukushima, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 November 1975.

features.role: Fukushima town emblem — a ring open at the sides enclosing a stylised spire with wings
